_comment: Worked example (engine 5.7, Andrew's ruling R2a, 2026-10-19; design 04_foreign A.2): the judgment.json interim_bridge MICC would declare for its H1 2026 6-K. Values are in full EUR units as presented in millions in the 6-K's condensed consolidated cash flow statement; every filing leg is also an undimensioned fact in the 6-K's own XBRL instance (micc-20260630x6k_htm.xml), which ttm.py --interim checks. The FY2025 leg is NOT declared: ttm.py reads it from the engine's own financials_history.csv / capex_provenance (FY2025: OCF EUR 483M, PP&E capex EUR 357M, intangibles EUR 3M, SBC EUR 35M). This file is an example only; no company folder is changed.
